old_caption: The video opens with a chaotic scene filled with bright flashes of light and billowing smoke. The camera captures a group of people, some holding long poles with burning, sparking heads, creating a vivid display of sparks and flames. The environment is intense, with the light from the pyrotechnic devices illuminating the scene. The camera then shifts focus to a close-up of a person's hand gripping a pole, which is a standalone object held by participants. The background is filled with a dense cloud of orange and yellow sparks, suggesting a firework or pyrotechnic display. The camera moves slightly and the focus shifts, emphasizing the intensity and the dynamic nature of the scene.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a chaotic scene filled with bright flashes of light and billowing smoke. The camera captures a group of people, some holding torches or flares, creating a vivid display of sparks and flames. The environment is intense, with the light from the torches illuminating the faces of the participants, who appear to be celebrating or participating in a ritualistic event. The camera then shifts focus to a close-up of a person's hand gripping a pole, which is part of a larger structure, possibly a flagpole or a ceremonial object. The background is filled with a dense cloud of orange and yellow sparks, suggesting a firework or pyrotechnic display. The camera remains steady on the hand and the pole, emphasizing the intensity and the dynamic nature of the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of excitement and celebration, with the bright lights and sparks creating a sense of energy and movement.
caption: Within a smoke-choked, fire-lit throng, silhouetted figures wearing horned helmets thrust long poles skyward as sparks streak through the haze. A blinding white-orange glare floods the right side early, washing out detail and leaving only the dark outlines of raised staffs and helmeted heads against the light. As the glare softens and drifts leftward, two of the poles appear to cross near their tips, forming an inverted V amid the swirling embers. The background settles into a uniform amber glow, and the framing tightens onto a single vertical pole gripped by a gloved hand in silhouette. A small dark shape tumbles past on the right. The view tilts upward along the shaft, revealing a curved, club-like head at its top. Embers continue to float across the orange sky as the pole stands held aloft among the crowd.
